opportunities.title: Funding for charities working with disability

amount.raw: Minimum grant amount £25,000; usual grant range £40,000 – £75,000

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Registered or exempt charities (or equivalent) and local authority; UK only; if applicable at least a 'Good' rating from CQC or Ofsted
opportunities.summary: Capital grants for new build, refurbishment and equipment to help people with disabilities live more independently, focusing on training, employment and supported housing.

opportunities.title: Funding for charities working in mental health

amount.raw: Minimum grant amount £25,000; usual grant range £40,000 – £75,000

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Registered or exempt charity (or equivalent) or a local authority; UK only; if applicable at least a 'Good' rating from CQC or Ofsted
opportunities.summary: Capital grants for new build, refurbishment and equipment for charities working in mental health, with emphasis on training, employment and supported housing.

opportunities.title: Funding for charities working with older people

amount.raw: Minimum grant amount £25,000; usual grant range £40,000 – £75,000

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Registered or exempt charity (or equivalent) or a local authority; UK only; if applicable at least a 'Good' rating from CQC
opportunities.summary: Capital grants for new buildings, refurbishment and equipment for organisations providing care and services for older people, particularly those with neurodegenerative conditions or who are isolated.

opportunities.title: Funding for historic buildings & landscapes

amount.raw: Minimum grant amount £15,000; usual grant range £15,000 – £100,000

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Registered or exempt charity (or equivalent) or local authority; UK only; sites of outstanding historic, architectural and cultural significance open to the public
opportunities.summary: Grants towards conservation and restoration work, interpretation, and education spaces at sites of outstanding historic, architectural and cultural significance with a focus on public access and engagement.

opportunities.title: Funding for hospices and palliative care organisations

amount.raw: Minimum grant amount £25,000; usual grant range £50,000 – £150,000

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Registered charities or hospices operating within the NHS; UK only; if applicable at least a 'Good' rating from CQC or equivalent
opportunities.summary: Capital grants for new buildings, refurbishment work and equipment for hospices and palliative care organisations providing excellent care to patients and families.

opportunities.title: Funding for libraries & archives

amount.raw: Minimum grant amount £15,000; usual grant range £15,000 – £100,000

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Registered or exempt charity (or equivalent) or local authority; UK only; fully accredited under Archive Service Accreditation Scheme; permanent collection of national significance
opportunities.summary: Grants for collection storage facilities and research, education or interpretation spaces at libraries and archives caring for nationally significant collections with a focus on public access.

opportunities.title: Funding for museums & galleries

amount.raw: Minimum grant amount £15,000; usual grant range £50,000 – £500,000

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Registered or exempt charity (or equivalent) or local authority; UK only; fully accredited under Museum Accreditation Scheme; permanent collection of national significance
opportunities.summary: Grants towards refurbishing or creating new galleries and education/learning spaces to improve the display and interpretation of nationally significant collections.

opportunities.title: Funding for performing arts organisations

amount.raw: Minimum grant amount £15,000; usual grant range £50,000 – £150,000

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Registered or exempt charity (or equivalent) or local authority; UK only; organisations focused on professional performance with significant education work
opportunities.summary: Grants towards building or refurbishing training and education facilities, and occasionally specialist equipment, for performing arts organisations.

opportunities.title: Funding for public engagement with science organisations

amount.raw: Minimum grant amount £100,000; usual grant range £250,000 – £750,000

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Registered or exempt charity (or equivalent), local authority or university; UK only; displaying scientific or natural history collections of national significance
opportunities.summary: Grants towards refurbishing or creating new galleries and education/learning spaces to improve public engagement with science through the history of science.

opportunities.title: Funding for special schools and colleges

amount.raw: Minimum grant amount £25,000; usual grant range £40,000 – £75,000

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Registered or exempt charity (or equivalent) or local authority; UK only; if applicable at least a 'Good' rating from CQC or Ofsted
opportunities.summary: Capital grants for new build, refurbishment and equipment for special schools and colleges supporting pupils at secondary level to develop skills for employment or independent living.

opportunities.title: Funding for universities and research institutions

amount.raw: Minimum grant amount £100,000; usual grant range £250,000 – £1 million

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Research-intensive universities and research institutions undertaking internationally competitive research; UK only
opportunities.summary: Grants towards new buildings, refurbishment work and major equipment to enable high-quality research at research-intensive universities and research institutions.

opportunities.title: Funding for secondary schools & sixth form colleges

amount.raw: Minimum grant amount £15,000; maximum grant amount £100,000; usual range £15,000 – £50,000 (equipment), £15,000 – £100,000 (new build/refurbishment)

opportunities.eligibility_summary: State-funded secondary schools and sixth form colleges; UK only; at least 'Good' Ofsted/Estyn/HMIE/ETI rating
opportunities.summary: Capital grants to help high-achieving state-funded secondary schools and sixth form colleges improve teaching of GCSE and A-Level subjects needing specialist spaces and equipment (science, computer science, design & technology, art, languages, music, performing arts). 2026 round closed; next round expected spring 2027.
